name: Colm Kelleher

summary.text: Colm Kelleher, formerly President of Morgan Stanley until June 2019, was nominated by the UBS board on 20 November 2021 and elected Chairman of UBS Group at the Annual General Meeting of 6 April 2022, succeeding Axel Weber. He was UBS chairman when UBS agreed on 19 March 2023 to take over Credit Suisse with Swiss state support.
